title: Move resume, activity, and handoff archive to .local/
description:
Move session-local files (`resume.json`, `activity.json`, and `handoff-archive/`) from tracked `.planner/` paths into `.planner/.local/`.

Code references:
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:727` — `resumePath()`
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:730` — `activityPath()`
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1800` — `handoffArchiveDir()`
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:975` — `saveResume()`
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1044` — `appendActivity()`
- `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts:1780` — `clearPhaseHandoff()` archives to `handoff-archive/`

Current state:
- `resume.json` contains per-session focus, nextSteps, and machine-local `guardBypassUntil`. It is gitignored by `init()` but may still be tracked in older projects.
- `activity.json` is an operational log.
- `handoff-archive/` stores cleared handoff markdown for audit.

Work to do:
1. Update `resumePath()` → `.planner/.local/resume.json`.
2. Update `activityPath()` → `.planner/.local/activity.json`.
3. Update `handoffArchiveDir()` → `.planner/.local/handoff-archive/`.
4. Update `saveResume()`, `loadResume()`, `authorizeGuardBypass()`, `clearGuardBypass()`, `isGuardBypassed()` to use the new path.
5. Update `appendActivity()`, `loadActivityLog()` to use the new path.
6. Update `clearPhaseHandoff()` archive path and history entries referencing archived files.
7. Add migration helper: if old `resume.json`/`activity.json` exist at root, move them into `.local/` on first access.
8. Update `.gitignore` generation to ignore `.local/` entirely.

Behaviors to preserve:
- Guard bypass timestamp must remain machine-local and not leak across clones.
- Existing handoff archives must remain reachable after migration.
- The resume protocol in adapters must continue to read the same data regardless of path.

tasks.title: Move resume.json and activity.json to .local/

3. Update `saveResume()`, `loadResume()`, `authorizeGuardBypass()`, `clearGuardBypass()`, `isGuardBypassed()`.
